  "decisions": [
    {
      "id": "D1",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-19T12:15:00Z",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "EmberDossier is a skill plus a FilePress explainer site, not a PocketBase web app.",
      "rationale": "GENESIS defines a prompting pattern. The site teaches the pattern. No accounts, sync, or shared data in v1.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "SvelteKit + PocketBase research app that generates dossiers at runtime",
        "Skill only, no public site"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D2",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-19T12:15:00Z",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "Sample subjects in the skill, site, and GENESIS stay gender-neutral or obviously generic.",
      "rationale": "Owner instruction. Real living people as examples invite bias and go stale. Generic orgs, places, topics, events, or clearly fictional names do the teaching job.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Use well-known public figures as running examples"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D3",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-19T12:15:00Z",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "Publishable prose follows aiBreze. Product speaks as EmberDossier / it.",
      "rationale": "House voice. Site and README are landing surfaces, not essays.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "No editorial overlay"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D4",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-19T12:15:00Z",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "ForgeTrail MCP-first. Persist `.forgetrail/` only. No vendored `_forgetrail/` tree.",
      "rationale": "Owner asked to start with ForgeTrail. Methodology stays on the server.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Copy Lite into the repo"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D5",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-19T12:15:00Z",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "Prune Phase 2 and Phase 7 exit criteria for a skill + static site. Keep archetype product.",
      "rationale": "CRUD, PocketBase, auth, and payments do not apply. Site build, skill load, and docs alignment do.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Leave the full-stack template rows and ignore them"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D6",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-19T13:50:00Z",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "Public URL is https://emberdossier.com.",
      "rationale": "Owner registered the domain.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "emberdossier.dev"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D7",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-19T13:50:00Z",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "npm package name is get-ember-dossier.",
      "rationale": "ember-dossier is taken. emberdossier is blocked by npm similar-name check (punctuation-stripped match). get-ember-dossier@0.0.0 published successfully on 2026-08-19.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "ember-dossier (taken)",
        "emberdossier (403 similar-name)",
        "getemberdossier",
        "@acmegeek/emberdossier",
        "@catalyst-forge/ember-dossier"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D8",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-19T13:50:00Z",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "Site depends on published getfilepress from npm, not a sibling link.",
      "rationale": "Owner: FilePress is an npm package. Clones should not need the filepress repo.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "link:../../filepress"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D9",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-19T13:50:00Z",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "Filled sample is Harborview Public Library: civic, invented, roles not names, operational disputes only.",
      "rationale": "Owner asked for a generic, non-controversial filled dossier. A library renovation teaches all seven sections without picking a news-cycle fight.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Usage lines only",
        "A corporate or political subject"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D10",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-19T14:05:00Z",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "Cloudflare Pages project name is emberdossier. Deploy with pnpm ship.",
      "rationale": "Matches emberdossier.com and the house FilePress ship script (build + wrangler pages deploy).",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "ember-dossier",
        "get-ember-dossier"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D11",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-19T14:15:00Z",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "Second filled sample is EmberDossier itself. Real, non-controversial, owner-named. /sample is an index of Harborview (invented) and EmberDossier (real).",
      "rationale": "Owner asked for a more complex real example and pointed at emberdossier.com. A self-sample teaches multiple artifacts (format, npm package, site) without a news-cycle fight.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Harborview only",
        "A third-party civic or corporate subject"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D12",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-19T14:24:00Z",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "Third filled sample is Framework Computer. Real, owner-supplied, independent (no affiliation). Founder named because the briefing named that person.",
      "rationale": "Owner asked for another real, mostly non-controversial example. A hardware company with a same-week product launch teaches recency, orbit, and a real controversy section without turning the sample set into news-cycle bait.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "EmberDossier + Harborview only"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D13",
      "timestamp": "2026-08-19T14:27:00Z",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "Call filled briefings examples on the site and in the skill. Nav and index are /examples. House phrase for demo subjects is example subjects.",
      "rationale": "Owner: site said sample, skill said examples. Examples matches the skill folder and how you ask an agent.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Sample everywhere",
        "Keep the split"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D16",
      "timestamp": "2026-09-04T21:52:00Z",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "decision": "Smell Check via published smellcheck from npm (^0.3.4), not a sibling link.",
      "rationale": "Owner: replace the link. Same pattern as getfilepress from npm so clones do not need the smellcheck repo.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "link:../smellcheck"
      ]
    }
  ],
